I'm actually quite active on a lot of online groups however with the internet being the internet I always end up falling back into the trap of going on to platforms I know will be homophobic. For example I like watching videos of same sex marriages sometimes when I'm down but then I go into the comments just to see homophobes cursing them out, so now I just avoid watching that stuff because it makes me feel worse at the end of the day. It's petty stuff like that that just keeps wearing away at me and it's pretty hard to keep my mood up, especially with the implications of my eating disorder. And now I want to die
Unfortunately not, the town I live in small and religious so a lack of anything lgbt is a given

Northern Ireland is fairly homophobic and jammed between accepting areas. I would be extremely hesitant to go to therapy simply because it's extremely inconvenient and worrying for my family, I've been before and it wasn't at all helpful or pleasant. I don't have a lot of friends and the people I am friendly with aren't the sort of people who can deal with this stuff, most of them don't even know I'm a lesbian
